messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Metering alert: upstream billing-emitter lag > 25m for eu1, overage-flag rate increased x3. Auto-page oncall.
maria_oncall: acked. paging in. checking console and customer impact now.
oliver: looking at emitter logs, seeing repeated 503s to /v2/usage/emit from emitter-worker-3.
raj: can you paste the last 2 lines from the worker log?
oliver: `2026-03-20T02:45:12Z ERROR emit failed status=503 retry=3 id=tx-9f2a`\n`2026-03-20T02:45:13Z WARN queue length=4200 target=2000 replaying`
emma: spike in queued messages + delayed daily-aggregates. billing dashboard shows token counts for several customers delayed ~30m.
billing-sre: what is the customer impact surface? any overage emails already sent?
support_lead: we've had 12 customer-facing overage flags since 02:40, 3 customers reported support tickets.
maria_oncall: initial assessment: emitter -> auth-proxy timeout cascades causing write retries and backlog. SLA risk if not mitigated.
raj: is this the v2.4.1 emitter push? I remember a retry reg change in that deploy.
oliver: yes v2.4.1 rolled to eu1 at 01:30. rollback or scale-out?
emma: while we decide, can we stop issuing new overage notifications? toggle: `billing.notifications.enabled=false` would prevent emails.
billing-sre: good call. will toggle now.
incident-bot: action_log: billing.notifications.enabled set to false by billing-sre at 6123460000.
maria_oncall: mitigation 1: disable customer notif. mitigation 2: scale emitter-workers + restart worker-3. mitigation 3: run small replay for held queue once healthy.
oliver: scaling workers now: `kubectl scale deploy/emitter-workers --replicas=6 -n prod-eu1` executed.
raj: restarting worker-3: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/emitter-worker-3 -n prod-eu1`.
oliver: worker-3 back up at 02:54, logs show successful 200s to /v2/usage/emit; queue draining.
emma: telemetry: backlog reduced from 4200 -> 600 in 9m, overage flags rate down to baseline.
support_lead: updated 3 customers who filed tickets: told them we are pausing overage alerts and replaying usage; ETA for full reconciliation 2 hours.
billing-sre: will run reconciliation job `usage-replay --window 00:30:00 --dryrun=false` after queue drains below 1k.
maria_oncall: temporary postmortem notes: probable regression in retry logic in v2.4.1 combined with auth-proxy transient errors. next steps: (1) run full replay, (2) collect emitter metrics for 24h, (3) schedule revert of v2.4.1 or patch retry policy.
incident-bot: incident status -> mitigated (notifications paused, queue draining). severity -> sev2. handoff to follow-up at 6123460450.
raj: adding logs to the incident doc: /runbooks/incidents/6123456789-emitter-lag-triage.md
oliver: leaving channel, monitoring in background. ping me if queue stalls.
emma: thanks team. I'll coordinate customer comms and prepare a short update for the all-hands. :white_check_mark:
support_lead: will keep support looped in. closing pager for oncall now, leaving follow-up to engineering.
